# Attention Is All You Need: The Paper That Revolutionized AI

Vijay Poudel

--

Listen

Share

In 2017, a groundbreaking paper titled “Attention Is All You Need” was published by a team of Google researchers, introducing the Transformer architecture. This innovation has since become the foundation of modern natural language processing (NLP) and is the driving force behind models like GPT-3, BERT, and ChatGPT. [...] ## Conclusion

The “Attention Is All You Need” paper didn’t just propose a new model — it reshaped the way we think about deep learning and NLP. By replacing recurrence with attention, the Transformer made it possible to process sequences faster and more effectively, enabling scalable, parallelizable models that drive the cutting-edge AI systems we use today.

--

--

Vijay Poudel
Vijay Poudel

## Written by Vijay Poudel [...] The team of researchers at Google, led by Ashish Vaswani and his colleagues, realized that one of the major limitations of RNNs and LSTMs was their reliance on sequential computation. This inherent bottleneck made it difficult to scale models effectively, especially when using GPUs or other parallel processing units, which are optimized for batch processing.
